metadata.title: चाईबासा के मंगला हाट में 15 हज़ार का मुर्गा | The famous Mangla Bazaar of Chaibasa, Jharkhand |
metadata.description: The Mangla Bazaar is a famous tribal haat in Chaibasa city of Jharkhand. This Bazaar is held on Tuesday in every week. Adivasis of the adjoining areas come to this Bazaar to sell forest produce and crops from their fields. But this Bazaar is known as a big cattle market also.
